articles.headline: Can Argentina's Estudiantes stop Brazil's Libertadores juggernaut?
articles.description: Brazilian clubs have won the last seven Copa Libertadores titles, but Argentina's Estudiantes de La Plata are determined to keep that streak from reaching eight.

images.name: Where does Messi rank in the top five players of all time?

articles.headline: Depay misses late penalty, Estudiantes advance to Libertadores semis after 17 years
articles.description: Estudiantes and Palmeiras advanced to the Copa Libertadores semifinals following dramatic quarterfinal ties against Corinthians and Liga de Quito.

images.name: Estudiantes [1296x729]
images.caption: Four-time Copa Libertadores champions Estudiantes advanced to the semifinals for the first time since 2009.

articles.headline: Fluminense advance past Platense to Copa Libertadores semifinals
articles.description: Despite a 2-1 loss to Argentina's Platense on Tuesday, Brazil's Fluminense secured a spot in the Copa Libertadores semifinals with a 3-2 aggregate victory.

articles.headline: Colombia earthquake forces postponement of Conmebol, league games
articles.description: Copa Libertadores, Copa Sudamericana and Colombian domestic league matches scheduled for this week have been postponed following a powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake that struck western Colombia on Monday.

articles.headline: Laurens: Neymar's situation 'really sad'
articles.description: Julien Laurens reacts to Neymar's current form and discusses his chances of making Brazil's World Cup squad.

articles.headline: Flamengo lift Copa Libertadores, but Brazil's players look exhausted
articles.description: Originally billed as the "final of the century," Saturday's Libertadores decider was a war of attrition -- mainly because Brazil's two top clubs are struggling to contend with a ridiculous match schedule.

images.name: Flamengo celebrates [1296x729]
images.caption: Flamengo defeated Palmeiras 1-0 in Saturday's Copa Libertadores final in Lima.
